description: Li15Y7Cl36 (58 atoms), CHGNet MolecularDynamics NVT, 1 fs, 400,000 steps, pretrained vs fine-tuned CHGNet models (training data described in each label).

method.reference: X. He, Y. Zhu, A. Epstein, Y. Mo, npj Comput. Mater. 4, 18 (2018)
method.msd: FFT time-averaged MSD, framework centre-of-mass drift removed
method.arrhenius: least squares on log10(D) vs 1000/T, weighted by sigma_log10D = log10(e)*D_std/D
method.stitching: continuation runs concatenated after dropping their duplicated first frame; equilibration frames removed only from the start of each chain
method.primary_fit: '<window> (no framework melt)': weighted, melted temperatures excluded
method.framework_melt_criterion: framework melted if the time-averaged MSD of framework (non-mobile) atoms at the end of the fit window exceeds site_distance^2; the original single-atom check (any framework atom displaced > 4 A) is recorded as framework_single_atom_moved_4A
